title: Universal Life Insurance Overloan Protection Rider Endorsement
content:
**Grant.** On a tier of Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance that includes the overloan protection rider, the owner may exercise overloan protection to prevent a lapse caused by indebtedness.

**Election.** Overloan protection is exercised only on an election signed by the owner and approved, as shown by the overloan protection election on the policy's service record.

**Conditions of exercise.** It may be exercised only when all of the following hold:

1. the insured's attained age is at least the tier's minimum exercise age;
2. the policy year is at least the tier's minimum exercise policy year;
3. indebtedness is at least the tier's indebtedness threshold share of the account value; and
4. the policy is not a modified endowment contract and would not become one.

**Effect of exercise.** On exercise monthly deductions stop and the death benefit option becomes Option A. Loan interest continues to accrue, but the policy can no longer lapse; no further premiums, withdrawals or new loans are accepted. The election cannot be revoked.

**Provisions no longer in force.** The provision that on exercise the tier's overloan charge percentage of the account value is deducted is no longer in force, and the provision that the face amount becomes the account value after the charge times the corridor factor at the insured's attained age, rounded to the cent, is no longer in force. Both have been superseded by the current basis for the overloan protection charge and the protected face. The tier's overloan charge percentage remains the tier's figure.

## Conditions in combination (hypothetical, on a tier that includes the rider; thresholds age 75, policy year 15, indebtedness 94%)

| Attained age | Policy year | Indebtedness share | Modified endowment contract, now or by exercise | May be exercised? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 76 | 16 | 95% | No | Yes |
| 74 | 16 | 95% | No | No (age) |
| 76 | 14 | 95% | No | No (policy year) |
| 76 | 16 | 92% | No | No (indebtedness) |
| 76 | 16 | 95% | Yes | No |

On a tier that does not include the rider, overloan protection is not available whatever the figures.
